name: Java Snippet Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/**'

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Determine if snippet tooling changed
        id: check
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Determine base commit
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            base_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          else
            base_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)
          fi

          # List changed files
          changed_files=$(git diff --name-only $base_sha ${{ github.sha }})
          echo "Changed files:" "$changed_files"

          # Flags
          non_sh_changed=false
          snippet_tooling_changed=false

          for file in $changed_files; do
            if [[ "$file" != *.sh ]]; then
              non_sh_changed=true
            fi
            if [[ "$file" == scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh || \
                  "$file" == scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh || \
                  "$file" == .github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml ]]; then
              snippet_tooling_changed=true
            fi
          done

          if $non_sh_changed; then
            echo "Non-script files changed, skipping snippet validation."
            echo "run=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif $snippet_tooling_changed; then
            echo "Snippet tooling changed, running validation."
            echo "run=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "No relevant snippet tooling changes, skipping."
            echo "run=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Set up Java
        if: steps.check.outputs.run == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Extract JavaDoc snippets
        if: steps.check.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts
          scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh CodenameOne/src > artifacts/snippets.jsonl
          echo "Extracted $(wc -l < artifacts/snippets.jsonl) snippets."

      - name: Validate snippets
        if: steps.check.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          failures=0
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            echo "Validating snippet: $line" >&2
            if ! echo "$line" | scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh; then
              echo "Snippet failed validation." >&2
              failures=$((failures+1))
            fi
          done < artifacts/snippets.jsonl
          if [ "$failures" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Validation failed for $failures snippets." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
